FIRST read `/root/.claude/projects/-root/memory/nxeon-marketing-design.md`. Then study the approved design system for cohesion: `components/marketing/gamelanding/{GameLandingCinematic,GameLandingEditorial,GameLandingConsole}.tsx` + `kit.tsx` + `data.ts`.

SHARED DESIGN LANGUAGE: tokens navy-950 #060a14 / brand-500 #6f47f5 / brand-400 #8a70fb / accent-blue #3b82f6 / accent-cyan #22d3ee, Geist, `grad-text`, `.card`, `.btn-primary`/`.btn-deploy`, `hero-aura`, glass + violet glow; cyan = "live" pop, never amber except warnings. Real imagery/product-screens as centerpiece; asymmetric/editorial layouts (NOT centered-stack); animated "live" elements; compact 5-star review element; the "47 seconds away" speed hook where relevant; buying-psychology focus; LESS text MORE presentation. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; mobile-responsive (390w). FORBIDDEN (rejected slop): centered-stack→particle-canvas→3-up-grid skeleton; fake globes (use `NetworkMap`); dead-space cards; text walls. Reusable showcase components in `components/marketing/showcase/` + `DeployCard`, `MatrixTerminal`, `NetworkMap`, `MigrationScreens`. Game art in `public/games/art/`.

**Template 1 — Competitor comparison / "vs" page (`/preview/comparison`, component under `components/marketing/comparisontemplate/`):** Nxeon vs a competitor (do "vs DigitalOcean" for VPS, OR "vs Shockbyte" for game hosting — pick one and commit). The centerpiece is a **visually-elevated head-to-head comparison table** (this format ranks in Google AND gets cited by AI assistants) — honest per-feature rows with clear win/tie visual indicators (cyan check for Nxeon wins, neutral for ties), price/speed/support/features. Add a "why teams switch" narrative section, a **free-migration CTA** (evolve `MigrationScreens`), compact reviews, and the 47s hook. Make the table beautiful, not a boring grid.

**Template 2 — Free-tier landing (`/preview/free-tier`, component under `components/marketing/freetiertemplate/`):** the free Minecraft / free VPS page — these are Nxeon's biggest acquisition magnets (52% of traffic comes from ChatGPT landing here). Lead on the Aternos-alternative wedge: **"24/7, no queue, no ads."** Elements: an animated "your free server" element (a live-looking free server card that wakes on join), an honest free-vs-paid comparison, a tasteful **free→paid upgrade teaser** (what you unlock by upgrading — this is the conversion bridge), a one-click "claim your free server" CTA, compact reviews. Keep it honest (it's genuinely free, auto-sleep/wake) but make it feel premium and trustworthy, not spammy.

CONCURRENCY CONSTRAINTS (7 agents share this tree): NET-NEW files only; do NOT touch existing live pages/shared components/MarketingHeader/GameLandingPage (READ OK). **Do NOT edit `app/globals.css`** — use co-located CSS Modules (`*.module.css`) or inline; REUSE existing `pv-*` keyframes. `npx tsc --noEmit` clean. Do NOT run `npm run build` and do NOT run a dev server / screenshots (main session does one pass). Report the 2 route paths + concerns.

- **Comparison:** asymmetric hero + an animated **honest scoreboard** (counts up "5 clear wins / 4 genuine ties / 0 losses" — derived from the table so it can't drift). Honest disclaimer baked in (trademark + "reflects our understanding").
- **Free-tier:** hero with the wedge + one-click **"Claim your free server"** → real `/dashboard/free-minecraft`. Signature element is an animated **"your free server" card that wakes on join** (sleeping → player connects → boot progress → online, player dots tick in, loops).
